name: io.github.callobuzz/cob-shopify-mcp
title: cob-shopify-mcp
description: Run a Shopify store from any MCP client: products, orders, customers, stock and analytics.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Your store's address, for example your-store.myshopify.com

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Shopify app (with SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET)

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your Shopify app (shpss_...)

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Admin API access token (shpat_...); used instead of the client ID and secret

environmentVariables.name: COB_SHOPIFY_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true to offer only the tools that read
